description.value: You fortify chosen allies within 30 feet of you at the moment of casting with resilience and grit. Each such creature sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius, gains advantage on all saving throws, and imposes disadvantage on attack rolls made against it. Whenever a dark side creature strikes one of these allies with a melee attack, that attacker must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the power ends.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 8
